body:
Eve: Quick sync — Tuesday webinar logistics: reg page, Zoom settings, recording backup, and follow-up cadence. Can we confirm owners?
Diego: Reg page done. Added timezone picker + EU consent checkbox for recordings. Link: https://redwood.ai/events/tech-tues
Riley: GA and UTM checks complete. All registrations push to HubSpot list 'TechTue-May'.
Nina (AV): Zoom: cloud recording ON, local backup on moderator laptop, OBS RTMP mirror to CDN as fallback. Will record separate audio tracks.
zoom-bot: Webinar scheduled: ID 555-777-999, start 2026-05-05T18:00:00Z. Cloud recording: enabled.
Hannah (Video): I'll take clips: hero 60s + 2x verticals. Need SRT dump to pull captions.
Nina (AV): Captioning: vendor will push SRT to s3://redwood-marketing/tech-tue/captions/. OBS command for greenroom: 
``
Start cloud record -> start OBS record -> confirm captions stream
``
Eve: Lead routing: registrants -> HubSpot -> tag 'tech_tue' -> zap -> Segment -> SDR queue. Attendees flagged attended=true. No-shows to replay drip.
Riley: Zap filter added to only mark attended when Zoom attendance webhook pings.
Eve: Follow-up schedule: 6h enterprise ping, 24h clips + survey, 72h replay + demo CTA. Hannah, can you deliver clips by +48h?
Hannah (Video): Yes, +48h for hero and verticals. I'll drop GDrive link when uploaded.
Diego: Greenroom 30m prior. Please paste final runbook snippets here before show.
Nina (AV): Confirmed. OBS scene named 'tech-tue-rtmp' and fallback bitrate set to 3.5 Mbps.
Eve: Thanks team. Confirm readiness by EOD.
Riley: Confirmed.
Hannah (Video): Confirmed.
Nina (AV): Confirmed.
